G3408.strongs: pay for service (literally or figuratively), good or bad

G3409.strongs: to let out for wages, i.e. (middle voice) to hire

In sense not found elsewhere, a hired dwelling: [[r:ACT.28.30|Act 28:30.]]† (AS)
(μισθόω), hired; as subst., ὁ μ., a hired servant, hireling: [[r:MRK.1.20|Mrk 1:20]], [[r:JHN.10.12|Jhn 10:12-13]].† (AS)

G3412.strongs: Mitylene (or Mytilene), a town on the island of Lesbos
senses: (late form - Strab., Plut. - of cl. Μυτιλ-), Mytilene, Mitylene, chief city of Lesbos: [[r:ACT.20.14|Act 20:14.]]† (AS)

G3413.forms: Μιχαήλ, ὁ indecl. (Heb. מִיכָאֵל, who like God?)

(μιμνήσκω), remembrance, mention (= μνήμη): [[r:PHP.1.3|Php 1:3]]; μ. ποιεῖσθαι, with genitive of person(s), [[r:ROM.1.9|Rom 1:9]], [[r:EPH.1.16|Eph 1:16]], [[r:1TH.1.2|1Th 1:2]], Phm 4 (cf. [[r:PSA.111.4|Psa 111:4]]); μ. ἔχειν, with genitive of person(s), [[r:1TH.3.6|1Th 3:6]], [[r:2TI.1.3|2Ti 1:3]] (on the seel. in [[r:ROM.12.13|Rom 12:13]], see ICC, in I.; Field, Notes, 163).† (AS)

a sepulchral monument, a sepulchre, tomb: [[r:MRK.5.3|Mrk 5:3, 5 15:46 16:2]] (WH, μνημεῖον), [[r:LUK.8.27|Luk 8:27 23:53 24:1]], [[r:ACT.2.29|Act 2:29 7:16]], [[r:REV.11.9|Rev 11:9]].† SYN.: μνημεῖον (AS)

(μνάομαι), memory, remembrance, mention: μ. ποιεῖσθαι, with genitive, to remember, [[r:2PE.1.15|2Pe 1:15]] (but in cl., π., μ. π. more frequently = to make mention, and so perh. here, cf. Mayor, in l; and for ex. from π., see Zorell, see word).† SYN.: μνεία, q.v (AS)

[[r:HEB.13.7|Heb 13:7]]; τ. πτωχῶν, [[r:GAL.2.20|Gal 2:20]]; with genitive of thing(s), [[r:JHN.15.20|Jhn 15:20 16:4, 21]], [[r:ACT.20.35|Act 20:35]]; with accusative obj. (as more frequently in cl.), of persons, [[r:2TI.2.8|2Ti 2:8]]; of things, [[r:MAT.16.9|Mat 16:9]], [[r:1TH.2.9|1Th 2:9]], [[r:REV.18.5|Rev 18:5]]; before ὅτι, [[r:ACT.20.31|Act 20:31]], [[r:EPH.2.11|Eph 2:11]], [[r:2TH.2.5|2Th 2:5]]; πόθεν, [[r:REV.2.5|Rev 2:5]]; πῶς, [[r:REV.3.3|Rev 3:3.]]
to make mention of: with genitive, [[r:HEB.11.15|Heb 11:15]] (but see supr., and cf. M, Th., I, 18); before περί, [[r:HEB.11.22|Heb 11:22.]]† (AS)

[[r:EZK.16.15|Eze 16:15]] ff. [[r:EZK.23.43|Eze 23:43]] ff., al.), [[r:JAS.4.4|Jas 4:4]]; as an adj., [[r:MAT.12.39|Mat 12:39 16:4]], [[r:MRK.8.8|Mrk 8:8]].† (AS)

senses: μολύνω to stain, soil, defile; in NT always symb. and figuratively: [[r:1CO.8.7|1Co 8:7]], [[r:REV.3.4|Rev 3:4 14:4]].† SYN.: μιαίνω, q.v (AS)
μομφή, ῆς, ἡ (μέμφομαι), poët. form of μέμψις, blame, com­plaint: [[r:COL.3.13|Col 3:13.]]† (AS)

senses: (μυρίος), ten thousand, a myriad: pl., [[r:ACT.19.19|Act 19:19]], [[r:REV.5.11|Rev 5:11 9:16]]; hyperb., of vast numbers, [[r:LUK.12.1|Luk 12:1]], [[r:ACT.21.20|Act 21:20]], [[r:HEB.12.12|Heb 12:12]], Ju 14.† (AS)
(μύρον), Ionic and poët. (comic), to anoint: [[r:MRK.14.8|Mrk 14:8.]]† SYN.: see: ἀλείφω, and cf. μύρον (AS)

G3463.strongs: ten thousand; by extension, innumerably many
senses: As a definite numeral, in pl., μύριοι, -αι, -α, ten thousand: [[r:MAT.18.24|Mat 18:24.]]† (AS)

G3465.strongs: Mysia, a region of Asia Minor

G3466.root: from a derivative of μύω (to shut the mouth)

senses: that which is known to the μύστης (initiated), a mystery or secret doctrine, mostly in pl., τὰ μ. (Æsch., Hdt., al.).

In later writers (Menand., Incert., 168), that which may not be revealed (not, however, as in the modern sense, intrinsically difficult to understand), a secret or mystery of any kind (To, Jth, 2Mac, ll, with).
In NT, of the counsels of God (cf. Th.: [[r:JOB.15.8|Job 15:8]], [[r:PSA.25.14|Psa 25:14]] for סוֹד), once hidden but now revealed in the Gospel or some fact thereof;

of the Christian revelation generally : [[r:ROM.16.25|Rom 16:25]], [[r:1CO.2.7|1Co 2:7]], [[r:COL.1.26|Col 1:26-27]], [[r:EPH.3.3|Eph 3:3]], 9; τ. βασιλείας τ. θεοῦ, [[r:MRK.4.11|Mrk 4:11]]; τ. θεοῦ, [[r:1CO.2.1|1Co 2:1]], [[r:REV.10.7|Rev 10:7]]; τ. θ., Χριστοῦ, [[r:COL.2.2|Col 2:2]]; τ. Χριστοῦ., [[r:COL.4.3|Col 4:3]], [[r:EPH.3.4|Eph 3:4]]; τ. θελήματος αὐτοῦ, [[r:EPH.1.9|Eph 1:9]]; τ. εὐαγγελίον, [[r:EPH.6.19|Eph 6:19]]; τ. πίστεως, [[r:1TI.3.9|1Ti 3:9]]; τ. εὐσεβείας, [[r:1TI.3.16|1Ti 3:16]];

of particular truths, or details, of the Christian revelation : [[r:ROM.11.25|Rom 11:25]], [[r:1CO.15.51|1Co 15:51]], [[r:EPH.5.32|Eph 5:32]], [[r:2TH.2.7|2Th 2:7]], [[r:REV.1.20|Rev 1:20 17:5, 7]]; pl., τὰ μ., [[r:1CO.13.2|1Co 13:2 14:2]]; θεοῦ, [[r:1CO.4.1|1Co 4:1]]; τ. βασιλείας τ. οὐρανῶν (θεοῦ), [[r:MAT.13.11|Mat 13:11]], [[r:LUK.8.10|Luk 8:10]] (cf. Westc., Eph., 180 ff.; AR, Eph., 234 ff.; Lft., Col., 165 f.; Hatch, Essays, 57 f.; DB, iii, 465 ff.; DCG, ii, 213 ff.).† (AS)

senses: μυ-ωπάζω (μύωψ, closing the eyes, short-sighted; μύω, ὤψ) to be short-sighted: [[r:2PE.1.9|2Pe 1:9]] (R, mg., closing his eyes; see ICC, in l).† (AS)

a ship: [[r:ACT.27.41|Act 27:41]] (elsewhere in NT always τ. πλοῖον; see M, [[r:PRO.25.1|Pro 25:1-28]] f.; Bl., Gosp., 186 f.).† (AS)

G3494.strongs: a youth (up to about forty years)

G3498.root: from an apparently primary νέκυς (a corpse)
G3498.strongs: dead (literally or figuratively; also as noun)
senses: prop.: [[r:ACT.5.10|Act 5:10 20:9]], [[r:JAS.2.26|Jas 2:26]], [[r:REV.1.18|Rev 1:18]], al.; ὡσεὶ ν., [[r:MAT.28.4|Mat 28:4]], [[r:MRK.9.26|Mrk 9:26]], [[r:REV.1.17|Rev 1:17]]; of that which is subject to death, [[r:ROM.8.10|Rom 8:10.]]

of persons: [[r:LUK.15.24|Luk 15:24, 32]]; of those immersed in worldly cares, [[r:MAT.8.22|Mat 8:22]], [[r:LUK.9.60|Luk 9:60]]; of spiritual death, [[r:JHN.5.25|Jhn 5:25]], [[r:ROM.6.13|Rom 6:13]], [[r:EPH.5.14|Eph 5:14]], [[r:REV.3.1|Rev 3:1]]; τ. παραπτώμασιν, [[r:EPH.2.1|Eph 2:1]], 5 [[r:COL.2.13|Col 2:13]]; of the opposite condition, ν. τῇ ἁμαρτίᾳ, [[r:ROM.6.11|Rom 6:11]];

G3415.root: middle voice of a derivative of [[w:G3306]] or perhaps of the base of [[w:G3145]] (through the idea of fixture in the mind or of mental grasp)
G3415.strongs: to bear in mind, i.e. recollect; by implication, to reward or punish
G3415.kjv: be mindful, remember, come (have) in remembrance
senses: reflexive, to remind oneself of, hence, to remember: with genitive of thing(s), [[r:MAT.26.75|Mat 26:75]], [[r:LUK.1.54|Luk 1:54, 72 24:8]], [[r:ACT.11.16|Act 11:16]], [[r:2PE.3.2|2Pe 3:2]], Ju 17; with neg., of sins, = to forgive, [[r:HEB.8.12|Heb 8:12 10:17]]" (LXX); with genitive of person(s), [[r:LUK.23.42|Luk 23:42]]; before ὅτι, [[r:MAT.5.23|Mat 5:23 27:63]], [[r:LUK.16.25|Luk 16:25]], [[r:JHN.2.17|Jhn 2:17, 22 12:16]]; ὡς, [[r:LUK.24.6|Luk 24:6]]; pf., μέμνημι, in Pres. sense (cl.), with genitive of person(s) (of thing(s)), [[r:1CO.11.2|1Co 11:2]], [[r:2TI.1.4|2Ti 1:4]]; pres., μιμνήσκομαι (only in late writers), with genitive of person(s), in sense of caring for, [[r:HEB.2.6|Heb 2:6]] (LXX) [[r:HEB.13.3|Heb 13:3]];

in passive sense, to be remembered, aor., ἐμνήσθην: before ἐνώπιον, with genitive of person(s) (cf. [[r:EZK.18.22|Eze 18:22]]), [[r:ACT.10.31|Act 10:31]], [[r:REV.16.19|Rev 16:19]] (cf. ἀνα-, ἐπ-ανα-, ὑπο- μιμνήσκω. The tenses of this verb are from the older μνάομαι).† (AS)
ἐγώ, genitive, etc., ἐμοῦ, ἐμοί, ἐμέ (enclitic μου, μοι, με), pl. ἡμεῖς, -ῶν, -ῖν, -ᾶς, of person(s) pron. I.

The nom. is usually emphatic, when expressed as subjc, as in [[r:MAT.3.11|Mat 3:11]], [[r:MRK.1.8|Mrk 1:8]], [[r:LUK.3.16|Luk 3:16]], al. But often there is no apparent emphasis, as [[r:MAT.10.16|Mat 10:16]], [[r:JHN.10.17|Jhn 10:17]]; ἰδοὺ ἐ. (= Heb. הִנֵּנִי, cf. [[r:1KI.3.8|1Ki 3:8]]), [[r:ACT.9.10|Act 9:10]]; ἐ. (like Heb. אֲנִי), I am, [[r:JHN.1.23|Jhn 1:23]] (LXX), [[r:ACT.7.32|Act 7:32]] (LXX).

The enclitic forms (see supr.) are used with nouns, adjectives, verbs, adverbs, where there is no emphasis: ἐν τ. πατρί μου, [[r:JHN.14.20|Jhn 14:20]]; μου τ. λόγους, [[r:MAT.7.24|Mat 7:24]]; ὀπίσω μου, [[r:MAT.3.11|Mat 3:11]]; ἰσχυρότερός μου, ib.; λέγει μοι, [[r:REV.5.5|Rev 5:5]]; also with the prep. πρός, as [[r:MRK.9.19|Mrk 9:19]], al. The full forms (ἐμοῦ, etc.) are used with the other prepositions, as δι᾽ ἐμοῦ, ἐν ἐμοί, εἰς ἐμέ, etc., also for emphasis, as [[r:LUK.10.16|Luk 10:16]], [[r:JHN.7.23|Jhn 7:23]], [[r:MRK.14.7|Mrk 14:7]], al. (with) The genitive μου and ἡμῶν are often used for the poss. pronouns ἐμός, ἡμέτερος: τ. λαόν μου, [[r:MAT.2.6|Mat 2:6]]; μου τῂ ἀπιστιᾳ, [[r:MRK.9.24|Mrk 9:24.]]

τί ἐμοὶ καὶ σοί ( = Heb. מַה־לִי וָלָךְ, [[r:JDG.11.12|Jdg 11:12]], al.), i.e. what have we in common: [[r:MAT.8.29|Mat 8:29]], [[r:MRK.1.24|Mrk 1:24, 5:7]], [[r:LUK.8.28|Luk 8:28]], [[r:JHN.2.4|Jhn 2:4]]; τί γάρ μοι, [[r:1CO.5.2|1Co 5:2.]]
The interchange of ἐγώ and ἡμεῖς, common in π., appears in Pauline Epp. (see M, Pr., 86f., M, Th., 131f.).

κἀγώ (= καὶ ἐγώ), and I, even I, I also: [[r:MAT.2.8|Mat 2:8]], [[r:LUK.2.48|Luk 2:48]], [[r:JHN.6.56|Jhn 6:56]], [[r:ROM.3.7|Rom 3:7]], [[r:1CO.7.40|1Co 7:40]], al.; κἀγώ... καί, both... and, [[r:JHN.7.28|Jhn 7:28.]] (AS)
